findings.title: Unrate-limited POST /api/bookings/create combined with hardcoded LIMIT 25 on GET /api/owner/requests allows spam starvation of vendor booking queues
findings.subsystem: S2: HTTP server core, routing, api/* handlers & DB adapter
findings.what_is_wrong: `POST /api/bookings/create` enforces no per-IP or per-user rate limit on booking inquiry creation, while `GET /api/owner/requests` executes `ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25` with zero cursor/offset pagination or status filter.
findings.evidence: `api/bookings/create.js:73-340` validates payload fields and idempotency keys without calling any rate-limit bucket (`pager_rate_limits` or in-memory IP/user limiter). `api/owner/requests.js:138-140`: `SELECT ... FROM bookings WHERE truck_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25` (no `OFFSET`, cursor, or `?status=pending` filter).
findings.expected_behavior: `POST /api/bookings/create` must enforce bounded per-IP and per-user rate limits (e.g., max 5 inquiries / 15 min per user/IP and max 2 pending inquiries per customer+vendor), and `GET /api/owner/requests` should support `?status=` filtering and cursor/offset pagination.
findings.actual_condition: 25 automated `POST /api/bookings/create` submissions for a vendor push all legitimate pending customer event inquiries permanently out of the vendor owner's dashboard view.
findings.impact: Denial-of-visibility against vendor event booking requests and database spam.
findings.root_cause: Legacy `api/bookings/create.js` and `api/owner/requests.js` were migrated from the serverless era without adding rate limits or pagination.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add per-user + per-IP rate limiting and a per-(customer, vendor) open-inquiry cap in `api/bookings/create.js`, and add `?status=` + `?limit=`/`?offset=` pagination to `api/owner/requests.js` (and `public/app.js:3348`, which further slices `.slice(0, 15)`!).
implementation_steps: In `api/bookings/create.js`, enforce a rate limit (e.g., max 5 requests per 15 minutes per user/IP) and cap pending bookings per `(user_id, truck_id)` to `3`.

In `api/owner/requests.js:135-145`, accept optional `status` (`pending`/`confirmed`/`declined`) and `limit` (`<= 50`, default `25`) + `offset`, and remove or raise the `.slice(0, 15)` truncation in `public/app.js:3348`.
findings.regression_risks: Preserve default bare-array/existing response shape on `GET /api/owner/requests` when pagination parameters are omitted (`docs/engineering/API-CONTRACTS.md`).
findings.verification_steps: Add a rate-limit and status-filter test in `tests/backend-hardening.integration.cjs`.

findings.title: Split-brain between BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS env grants and platform_roles DB rows breaks ticket assignment, account filters, and CLI checks
findings.subsystem: S3: Admin governance backend
findings.what_is_wrong: `loadAccessContext` (`lib/authz.js:298`) grants `Admin: Top` in memory if a `user_id` is listed in `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS`, even when that user has no row in `platform_roles`. However, SQL queries in `/api/admin/issues` assignee validation (`server/admin-routes.js:6080`), `/api/admin/accounts?role=top` (`line 4231`), `/api/admin/issues` staff filter (`line 5562`), `count_eligible_active_top_admins()` (`migrations/026`), and `scripts/manage-feature-controls.cjs:170` check `platform_roles` exclusively.
findings.evidence: `lib/authz.js:298` checks `envAdminIds.has(userId)` to set `isTopAdmin = true`, whereas `server/admin-routes.js:6080` validates ticket `assigned_to_user_id` via `SELECT role FROM platform_roles WHERE user_id = $1` (returning `400 INVALID_ASSIGNEE` for env-only Top Admins!) and `scripts/manage-feature-controls.cjs:170` rejects `--actor-email` if absent from `platform_roles`.
findings.expected_behavior: `platform_roles` in PostgreSQL (`scripts/bootstrap-top-admin.cjs`, guarded by Migration `026` triggers) should be the single authoritative source of `Admin: Top` / `Admin: Mod` grants, or `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` should be deprecated/retired now that `bootstrap-top-admin.cjs` is standard.
findings.actual_condition: Admins granted authority via `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` experience partial broken behavior across ticket assignment, account listing, last-Top invariants, and operator CLIs.
findings.impact: Inconsistent RBAC enforcement, `400 INVALID_ASSIGNEE` errors in support triage, and confusion during admin offboarding.
findings.root_cause: `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` was an early pre-Migration-018 bootstrap mechanism left active alongside `platform_roles` (`admin_bootstrap_grants`).
findings.recommended_remediation: Verify neither hosted environment relies on `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` without matching `platform_roles` rows, sync/deprecate `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` in favor of `scripts/bootstrap-top-admin.cjs`, or include `parsePlatformAdminIds()` in assignee/account queries if retained.
implementation_steps: Confirm on staging/ops docs whether `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` can be retired in favor of `scripts/bootstrap-top-admin.cjs` (`platform_roles`).

Until retired, include `parsePlatformAdminIds()` in `server/admin-routes.js:6080` (`INVALID_ASSIGNEE` check) and log a startup deprecation warning when `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` contains IDs missing from `platform_roles`.
findings.dependencies: Operator verification that all active Top Admins exist in `platform_roles`.
findings.regression_risks: Check `tests/admin-governance.integration.cjs` and `tests/backend-hardening.integration.cjs` for test fixtures that inject `BITESHARK_PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS` instead of `platform_roles` rows!
findings.verification_steps: Run `npm run test:admin` and `npm run test:hardening` after aligning assignee lookup or deprecating env-only grants.

findings.title: Sliding-window DB session extension runs on routes that omit Set-Cookie, desynchronizing auth_sessions.expires_at from browser cookie Max-Age
findings.subsystem: S1: Auth, sessions, age policy & test-customer sandbox
findings.what_is_wrong: `resolveSessionFromRequest` (`lib/standalone-auth.js:2596-2611`) mutates `auth_sessions.expires_at` in PostgreSQL once the session crosses its half-life and returns `refreshedCookie`, expecting the caller to emit `Set-Cookie`. However, `server/app.js` calls `resolveSessionFromRequest` at `lines 1121` and `1345` (public HTML / `/s/<token>` routes) while completely discarding `sess.refreshedCookie`! Once `auth_sessions.expires_at` is pushed forward in PostgreSQL, subsequent `/api/*` requests see `remaining > halfLife` and **never emit `Set-Cookie` again**, causing the browser to abruptly delete `__Host-truckly_session` at its original `Max-Age` while the DB session looks active.
findings.evidence: `server/app.js:523` attaches `sess.refreshedCookie` on `/api/*`, whereas `server/app.js:1121` (`const sess = await auth.resolveSessionFromRequest(req);`) and `server/app.js:1345` (`sess = await auth.resolveSessionFromRequest(req);`) ignore `sess.refreshedCookie` after `maybeExtendSessionIfNeeded` has already updated `auth_sessions.expires_at` in PostgreSQL!
findings.expected_behavior: Read-only session resolution on HTML / `/s/<token>` routes must pass `{ allowRenewal: false }` so DB sliding-window extension occurs ONLY when the HTTP response actually emits `appendSetCookie(res, sess.refreshedCookie)` (and never on `/s/<token>`, where `Set-Cookie` must not vary caching or headers).
findings.actual_condition: Visiting `/` or `/s/<token>` past session half-life extends `auth_sessions.expires_at` in PostgreSQL without updating browser cookie `Max-Age`, preventing subsequent `/api/*` calls from refreshing the cookie and causing premature client logout.
findings.impact: Unexpected mid-session customer/vendor/admin logouts at initial cookie `Max-Age` despite active usage.
findings.root_cause: `resolveSessionFromRequest` coupled read resolution with mutating sliding-window DB updates unconditionally.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add `{ allowRenewal = true }` to `resolveSessionFromRequest` (`lib/standalone-auth.js`); pass `{ allowRenewal: false }` on `/s/<token>` (`server/app.js:1345`) and emit `appendSetCookie(res, sess.refreshedCookie)` on first-party HTML routes (`/`, `/profile`, `/admin`) when `refreshedCookie` is returned.
implementation_steps: In `lib/standalone-auth.js:2560-2615`, accept `options = { allowRenewal: true }` in `resolveSessionFromRequest` and skip `maybeExtendSessionIfNeeded` when `options.allowRenewal === false`.
In `server/app.js:1345` (`/s/<token>`), pass `{ allowRenewal: false }`; in `server/app.js:1121` and `1268` (`/admin`, `/profile`), append `sess.refreshedCookie` via `appendSetCookie` when non-null.
findings.regression_risks: Never emit `Set-Cookie` on `/s/<token>` or `/s/<token>/photo/<attachment>` responses.
findings.verification_steps: Add a test in `tests/standalone-runtime-auth.integration.cjs` advancing past session half-life, requesting `/s/<token>` (asserting DB `expires_at` is unchanged), then requesting `/api/auth/session` and asserting `Set-Cookie` is emitted.

findings.title: Soft-deleted idempotency_key collisions trigger unhandled PostgreSQL 23505 HTTP 500s across visits, photos, trails, and collections
findings.subsystem: S4: Customer profile, Greatest Hits sharing, exploration & photos
findings.what_is_wrong: Unique idempotency indexes in Migrations `027` and `029` (`idx_customer_visits_user_idempotency`, `idx_customer_photos_user_idempotency`, `idx_customer_saved_trails_user_idempotency`, `idx_customer_collections_user_idem`) span soft-deleted rows (`WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL`, without `AND deleted_at IS NULL`). When `logUserVisit`, `createUserPhoto`, `saveUserTrail`, or `createOwnerCollection` finds an existing row with `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`, it skips idempotent replay and `INSERT`s a new row with the same `cleanIdemp`—crashing with PostgreSQL `23505` (`500`). This occurs naturally when re-importing legacy IndexedDB photos (`legp_idx_0` at `public/exploration-client.js:975`) after deleting an earlier imported photo.
findings.evidence: Compare `lib/customer-exploration.js:2619-2624` (`importLegacyDeviceVisits`), which explicitly guards `const effectiveIdemp = existingIdemp.rows.length === 0 ? idempKey : null;`, against `lib/customer-exploration.js:896, 1268, 2377` and `lib/customer-profile.js:1768`, which check `if (idempRes.rows.length > 0 && !idempRes.rows[0].deleted_at)` and then pass `cleanIdemp` straight into `INSERT`.
findings.expected_behavior: Reusing an `idempotency_key` that previously belonged to a soft-deleted record must create the new record cleanly (`201`) without hitting `23505` `500`, and soft-deletion should clear `idempotency_key = NULL` on deleted rows.
findings.actual_condition: Re-submitting or re-importing (`legp_idx_0`) after soft-deleting a visit, photo, trail, or collection throws an unhandled `23505` unique constraint violation (`500`).
findings.impact: HTTP `500` failures on legacy photo re-imports and retried exploration/collection creations after deletion.
findings.root_cause: Application insert paths assumed partial unique indexes excluded `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`, whereas `migrations/027` and `029` indexed all non-null `idempotency_key` rows.
findings.recommended_remediation: Clear `idempotency_key = NULL` in all soft-delete `UPDATE` queries (`deleteUserVisit`, `deleteUserPhoto`, `deleteUserSavedTrail`, `deleteOwnerCollection`, `clearCustomerProfileAndCollectionsData`) AND pass `null` for `idempotency_key` on `INSERT` if the pre-insert lookup finds a soft-deleted row (requiring zero edits to immutable Migrations `027`/`029`).
implementation_steps: In `logUserVisit`, `createUserPhoto`, `saveUserTrail` (`lib/customer-exploration.js`), and `createOwnerCollection` (`lib/customer-profile.js`), set `const effectiveIdemp = idempRes.rows.length > 0 ? null : cleanIdemp;` once `!idempRes.rows[0].deleted_at` replay has been checked.
In `deleteUserVisit`, `deleteUserPhoto`, `deleteUserSavedTrail`, `deleteOwnerCollection`, and `clearCustomerProfileAndCollectionsData`, include `, idempotency_key = NULL` in `SET deleted_at = $...`.
findings.dependencies: None (pure application SQL fix; preserves immutable migration checksums).
findings.regression_risks: None; active rows (`deleted_at IS NULL`) continue returning idempotent replay responses unchanged.
findings.verification_steps: Add tests in `tests/customer-exploration.integration.cjs` and `tests/customer-profile-sharing.integration.cjs` creating, deleting, and re-creating a visit, photo (`legp_idx_0`), trail, and collection with the same `idempotency_key` (`201`).

findings.title: Greatest Hits sharing UI hardcodes confirm_shared_view_update: true, wipes unsaved draft edits on share/photo actions, and caches stale photos
findings.subsystem: S8: Role-experience, Admin Portal, Style Guide & Profile UI
findings.what_is_wrong: (1) `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js:596-602` hardcodes `confirm_shared_view_update: true` on `attachCollectionPhoto`, bypassing the server's `409 SHARED_VIEW_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` live-publication warning when an `include_shared_photos: true` link is already active. (2) `rerender()` (`lines 356-360`) re-renders `#ghCollectionsHost.innerHTML` without calling `syncDraftFieldsFromDom`, and share/photo mutations call `ctx.reloadEditor()`, wiping unsaved `ghState` title/intro/recommendation edits and newly added spots. (3) `shState.ownerPhotosCache` (`lines 547-555`) is populated once and never invalidated when photos are uploaded or deleted.
findings.evidence: `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js:601`: `confirm_shared_view_update: true`. `lines 356-360`: `rerender` calls `triggerRerender()` without syncing DOM inputs; `lines 463, 514, 533, 606, 627` invoke `ctx.reloadEditor()`. `line 547`: `if (shState.ownerPhotosCache === null && window.bitesharkExploration)`.
findings.expected_behavior: Attaching a photo onto a live photo-sharing collection must require explicit user confirmation (`confirm_shared_view_update`), DOM draft text must be synced/preserved across preview/share/photo UI interactions, unsaved draft spots must prompt to save before attaching photos, and opening the photo picker must refresh the user's current private photos.
findings.actual_condition: Live shared collections update silently on photo attach without confirmation, unsaved text is lost when opening preview or photo picker, and newly uploaded photos do not appear in the Greatest Hits picker until a full page reload.
findings.impact: Data loss of unsaved customer writing, stale photo picker UX, and weakened live-share consent UX.
findings.root_cause: `greatest-hits-sharing.js` bolted onto `greatest-hits.js` via hook callbacks without sharing `syncDraftFieldsFromDom` or invalidating `ownerPhotosCache`.
findings.recommended_remediation: Sync DOM fields inside `rerender`, block or prompt before `reloadEditor` when `ghState.dirty` is true, require explicit confirmation when live `include_shared_photos` shares exist, and refresh `listPhotos` whenever opening the picker.
implementation_steps: In `public/greatest-hits.js`, call `syncDraftFieldsFromDom(root)` inside `window.bitesharkGreatestHitsHooks.rerender` before rebuilding HTML, and hide `[data-gh-open-photo-picker]` on unsaved draft spots (`!persistedSpotSet.has(vid)`).

In `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js:596-605`, pass `confirm_shared_view_update: Boolean(liveUpdateConfirmed)` and surface an explicit confirmation prompt on `409 SHARED_VIEW_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` (matching `greatest-hits.js:764-766`).
In `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js:547-555`, fetch fresh `window.bitesharkExploration.listPhotos({ limit: 12 })` each time `[data-gh-open-photo-picker]` opens.
findings.regression_risks: Check `tests/customer-profile-browser.e2e.cjs` photo-attach steps if a share link with `include_shared_photos: true` is already active before photo attachment.
findings.verification_steps: Run `npm run test:profile:browser` and add an E2E assertion verifying unsaved `#ghEditIntroInput` text survives opening Preview and Photo Picker.

findings.title: POST /api/me/shares/update-settings is disconnected from UI, and share rotate/update-settings ignore lazy time expiration
findings.subsystem: S4: Customer profile, Greatest Hits sharing, exploration & photos
findings.what_is_wrong: `POST /api/me/shares/update-settings` and `window.bitesharkProfile.updateShareSettings` are implemented and API-tested, but have **zero UI callers** in `public/*.js` (`public/greatest-hits-sharing.js:218-246` renders only `Replace / rotate link` and `Revoke`). Furthermore, because `customer_collection_shares.status` remains `"active"` in PostgreSQL after `expires_at` passes, both `updateCollectionShareSettings` (`line 2724`) and `rotateCollectionShareLink` (`line 2862`) treat expired shares as active—and `rotateCollectionShareLink` copies the past `cur.expires_at` (`line 2893`) onto the newly minted link!
findings.evidence: Search across `public/` for `updateShareSettings` or `/api/me/shares/update-settings` finds only its definition in `public/profile-client.js:272-281, 327`. In `lib/customer-profile.js:2862-2895`, `rotateCollectionShareLink` checks `if (cur.status !== "active")` without checking `cur.expires_at <= now`, and sets `nextExpiresAt = ... cur.expires_at`.
findings.expected_behavior: Active share rows in `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js` should expose an `"Edit disclosures / expiry"` panel wired to `updateShareSettings`, and `rotateCollectionShareLink` / `updateCollectionShareSettings` must reject time-expired links (`cur.expires_at <= now`) with `409 SHARE_EXPIRED` unless explicitly renewed.
findings.actual_condition: Users cannot toggle `include_shared_photos`, `include_display_name`, or expiration on an existing link without revoking the URL, and rotating a time-expired share via API mints a dead link.
findings.impact: Disconnected backend feature forcing unnecessary link revocations and broken lazy-expiration state transitions.
findings.root_cause: UI wiring for `updateShareSettings` was omitted from `greatest-hits-sharing.js`, and lazy `expires_at` evaluation was enforced on `GET` reads but forgotten in `rotate`/`update-settings` mutations.
findings.recommended_remediation: Reject `cur.expires_at <= now` in `updateCollectionShareSettings` and `rotateCollectionShareLink`, and wire an inline `"Edit shared details"` toggle panel on active shares in `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js`.

In `public/greatest-hits-sharing.js:218-246`, add an `"Edit disclosures & expiry"` button/panel on each active share calling `window.bitesharkProfile.updateShareSettings` (prompting for `confirm_shared_view_update` when broadening disclosures).

findings.title: Four governance workflow bugs: dismissed community reports stay stuck in queue, re-resolved tickets break 30-day reopen & mismatch SLA labels, /api/issues truncates at LIMIT 50 before ?id=, and Mod overwrites Top onboarding status
findings.subsystem: S3: Admin governance backend
findings.what_is_wrong: (1) `dismiss_reports` (`server/admin-routes.js:5438`) marks `community_reports` dismissed without decrementing/resetting `community_reviews.report_count` (incremented at `line 2969`), while `reported` queue filtering (`line 5320`) checks `r.report_count > 0 OR open_reports > 0`—trapping dismissed posts in the `reported` queue forever! (2) Resolving a reopened support ticket (`line 6153`) uses `resolved_at = COALESCE(resolved_at, now())`, keeping the *first* resolution timestamp so customers lose their 30-day reopen window (`canCustomerReopenTicket`), while `lib/support-tickets.js` displays SLA labels `24h / 72h / 7d` (`line 48`) that contradict `computeIssueSlaDueAt` (`12h / 48h / 96h` at `line 260`). (3) `GET /api/issues` (`lines 2202-2295`) fetches `ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50` *before* filtering `?id=` or `?ticket=`, returning `404` on single-ticket lookups once a user or vendor exceeds 50 historical tickets. (4) `Admin: Mod` recording an onboarding recommendation (`line 3450`) overwrites `Admin: Top`'s `needs_info_correction` status back to `under_review`, and Top's `suspend` action (`line 3505`) sets `vendors.ownership_status = "suspended"` with no unsuspend action in `/api/admin/vendors/status`.
findings.evidence: `server/admin-routes.js:5320`: `(r.report_count > 0 OR COALESCE(rep.open_reports, 0) > 0)` vs `line 5438` (`UPDATE community_reports SET status = 'dismissed'`, `community_reviews.report_count` untouched). `line 6153`: `resolved_at = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN COALESCE(resolved_at, now()) ...`. `lines 2202-2295`: SQL `LIMIT 50` runs before JS `singleId`/`singleTicket` match. `lib/support-tickets.js:48` (`within 24 hours`, `within 3 business days`, `within 7 days`) vs `line 260` (`12`, `48`, `96` hours).
findings.expected_behavior: `dismiss_reports` should reset `report_count = 0` (or filter `reported` strictly on `open_reports > 0`); re-resolving a reopened ticket must stamp fresh `resolved_at = now()` and clear `resolved_at = NULL` on reopen (with aligned SLA hours/labels); `GET /api/issues?id=...` / `?ticket=...` must filter in SQL before `LIMIT 50`; and `Admin: Mod` recommendations must preserve `needs_info_correction` while `/api/admin/vendors/status` can reinstate suspended `ownership_status`.
findings.actual_condition: Dismissed community posts remain permanently stuck in moderation; re-resolved tickets expire prematurely; older tickets `404` on direct lookup; and Mod/Top onboarding states can collide or strand a vendor.
findings.impact: Degraded moderator queue hygiene, broken customer ticket reopen guarantees, broken ticket deep-links past 50 issues, and stuck vendor onboarding states.
findings.root_cause: Denormalized `report_count` and `COALESCE(resolved_at, now())` were written for single-pass workflows without testing dismiss/reopen cycles or >50-ticket accounts.
findings.recommended_remediation: Fix all four SQL/state-machine transitions in `server/admin-routes.js` and align SLA copy vs `computeIssueSlaDueAt` in `lib/support-tickets.js`.
implementation_steps: In `server/admin-routes.js:5320, 5438`, filter `reported` queue on `COALESCE(rep.open_reports, 0) > 0` and reset `UPDATE community_reviews SET report_count = 0 WHERE id = $1` on `dismiss_reports`.

In `server/admin-routes.js:6153` (and customer reopen handler), set `resolved_at = now()` whenever transitioning into `resolved`/`closed`, clear `resolved_at = NULL` on reopen, and reconcile SLA hours/labels in `lib/support-tickets.js:48, 260`.
In `server/admin-routes.js:2202-2295`, push `AND i.id = $N` / `AND i.ticket_number = $N` into the SQL `WHERE` clause prior to `LIMIT 50`.

In `server/admin-routes.js:3450`, keep `status = CASE WHEN status = 'needs_info_correction' THEN status ELSE 'under_review' END` on Mod recommendation, and allow `Admin: Top` to restore `ownership_status` in `/api/admin/vendors/status`.
findings.dependencies: Check `lib/support-tickets.js` SLA expectations with product if changing `12h/48h/96h` vs `24h/72h/7d` copy.
findings.regression_risks: Verify `tests/admin-governance.integration.cjs` and `tests/support-feedback.integration.cjs` assertions on `report_count` and SLA timestamps.
findings.verification_steps: Add regression tests in `tests/admin-governance.integration.cjs` (`dismiss_reports` removes item from `reported` queue) and `tests/support-feedback.integration.cjs` (re-resolving a ticket resets 30-day reopen window; `?ticket=` works past 50 rows).

findings.title: Off-by-one 1-based state.step vs 0-based steps array in public/pager.js announces wrong pickup stage and aria-current="step"
findings.subsystem: S7: Customer-facing SPA frontend
findings.what_is_wrong: In `public/pager.js:7-11`, `pagerStates` defines 1-based `step` numbers (`cooking: 1`, `almost: 2`, `ready: 3`, `collected: 4`, `cancelled: 0`), whereas `steps = ['Cooking', 'Almost there', 'Ready!', 'Picked up']` (`line 228`) uses 0-based `map((label, i) => ...)` (`lines 230-233`: `i < state.step ? "complete" : i === state.step ? "current" : "waiting"`).
findings.evidence: `public/pager.js:7-11` (`cooking.step = 1`, `almost.step = 2`, `ready.step = 3`, `cancelled.step = 0`) vs `lines 231-233`: when `status === "cooking"` (`step = 1`), index `0` (`"Cooking"`) gets `complete` and index `1` (`"Almost there"`) gets `aria-current="step"`; when `status === "almost"` (`step = 2`), `"Ready!"` gets `aria-current="step"`; when `status === "ready"` (`step = 3`), `"Picked up"` gets `aria-current="step"`; and when `status === "cancelled"` (`step = 0`), `"Cooking"` gets `aria-current="step"`!
findings.expected_behavior: When `status === "cooking"`, `"Cooking"` (`i === 0`) is `current`; when `"almost"`, `"Almost there"` (`i === 1`) is `current`; when `"ready"`, `"Ready!"` (`i === 2`) is `current`; when `"collected"`, all 4 steps are `complete`; and when `"cancelled"`, zero steps are marked `current` (`aria-current="step"` omitted).
findings.actual_condition: Visual step indicators and screen-reader `aria-current="step"` / `(current step)` announcements are shifted one stage ahead of the actual kitchen status (prematurely telling blind/screen-reader users `"Ready! (current step)"` while food is only `"almost"`!).
findings.impact: Customer confusion at pickup counters and inaccurate WCAG `aria-current` announcements.
findings.root_cause: 1-based `step` integers were compared directly against 0-based `.map((label, i))` array indices.
findings.recommended_remediation: Compare `const stepIndex = state.step - 1;` (`cancelled` -> `-1`, `collected` -> `4` so `i < 4` marks all 4 `complete`!) in `public/pager.js:230-234`.
implementation_steps: In `public/pager.js:230-234`, handle `p.status === "cancelled"` by marking all steps `"waiting"` with no `aria-current`, handle `p.status === "collected"` by marking all 4 steps `"complete"`, and otherwise compare `i` against `const activeIdx = state.step - 1;`.
findings.dependencies: Check `tests/pager-demo.test.cjs` and `tests/pager-notifications-browser.e2e.cjs` for any snapshot/DOM class assertions on `.pager-roadmap li`.
findings.regression_risks: Update `tests/pager-demo.test.cjs` if it asserted the previous off-by-one classes.
findings.verification_steps: Run `npm run test:pager` and `npm run test:pager:browser`, asserting `status === "ready"` sets `aria-current="step"` on `"Ready!"` (`li:nth-child(3)`).

findings.title: Style Guide workspace defects: permanently 0/15 completed categories, unvalidated /reset endpoint, >200 save-all failure, KV editor coercion, missing no-cache headers, and sync FS blocking
findings.subsystem: S6: Feature controls & Style Guide admin workspace
findings.what_is_wrong: Six functional/operational issues affect `/admin#style-guide`: (1) `computeStyleGuideChangeReport` (`lib/style-guide-admin.js:568`) filters `t.remaining === 0`, a property that does not exist on `summarizeByTopic` rows (`unanswered` + `draft` exist instead), permanently reporting `categories_completed: 0` and `15/15 categories left`; (2) `POST /api/admin/style-guide/reset` (`lines 1220-1290`) skips `validateStyleGuideData`, allowing resets of `ref:DEC-*` targets to leave workspace state invalid and brick subsequent saves/pushes; (3) `#sgSaveAllDirtyBtn` (`public/admin-style-guide.js:2776`) sends all dirty items in one `POST`, which fails if `updates.length > 200` (`lib/style-guide-admin.js:911`, or future schema expansion); (4) `syncKvDomToDraft` (`public/admin-style-guide.js:1593`) drops duplicate in-progress keys and coerces numbers/booleans into strings while typing; (5) `/admin-style-guide.js` and `/admin-style-guide.css` are omitted from `NO_CACHE_STATIC_FILES` (`server/app.js:79-124`), serving `max-age=300` stale bundles after deploy; and (6) `GET /api/admin/style-guide` runs synchronous `fs.*Sync` + dual 18-file Markdown generation on every request without hiding `#navStyleGuideBtn` when `admin_style_guide_workspace` is `hidden`.
findings.evidence: `lib/style-guide-admin.js:568`: `const completedTopics = currentTopicSummary.filter(t => t.remaining === 0).length;` (`t.remaining` is `undefined`!). `lines 1220-1290`: `resetStyleGuideAdminDecisions` writes `wsState` without calling `validateStyleGuideData`. `server/app.js:79-124`: includes `"/admin.js"` and `"/admin.css"` in `NO_CACHE_STATIC_FILES` while omitting `"/admin-style-guide.js"` and `"/admin-style-guide.css"`.
findings.expected_behavior: Category completion must compute `(t.unanswered + t.draft) === 0` (or `t.unanswered === 0`); `/reset` must run `validateStyleGuideData` before writing; `#sgSaveAllDirtyBtn` must chunk batches at `<= 200`; `/admin-style-guide.{js,css}` must be in `NO_CACHE_STATIC_FILES`; `#navStyleGuideBtn` must respect `hidden`/`paused` feature controls; and rendered Markdown previews should be cached in memory keyed on `(baseSha, wsState.revision)`.
findings.actual_condition: Admin UI permanently displays `0` completed categories, caches stale Style Guide JS/CSS for 5 minutes across deploys, re-renders 36 Markdown documents synchronously on every GET, and allows `/reset` to break cross-decision `ref:DEC-*` integrity.
findings.impact: Inaccurate completion telemetry in the GitHub upload modal, stale admin bundles post-deploy, main-thread latency spikes on 1-vCPU VPS, and unvalidated `/reset` state corruption.
findings.root_cause: Rapid iteration on the Style Guide workspace left field-name mismatches (`remaining` vs `unanswered`), missed `NO_CACHE_STATIC_FILES` registration, and skipped caching generated Markdown.
findings.recommended_remediation: Fix `t.remaining`, validate `/reset`, chunk save batches, add `/admin-style-guide.{js,css}` to `NO_CACHE_STATIC_FILES`, wire `#navStyleGuideBtn` visibility to `admin_style_guide_workspace`, and memoize `generateStyleGuideOutputs` by `(repoHead, wsRevision)`.
implementation_steps: In `lib/style-guide-admin.js:568`, compute `const completedTopics = currentTopicSummary.filter(t => (Number(t.unanswered || 0) + Number(t.draft || 0)) === 0 && Number(t.total || 0) > 0).length;`.

In `lib/style-guide-admin.js:1255-1280`, validate merged decisions via `validateStyleGuideData` before persisting `resetStyleGuideAdminDecisions`, and cache `generateStyleGuideOutputs` in memory keyed by `wsState.revision`.

Add `"/admin-style-guide.js"` and `"/admin-style-guide.css"` to `NO_CACHE_STATIC_FILES` in `server/app.js:79-125`, chunk `#sgSaveAllDirtyBtn` requests into slices of `150`, preserve primitive types in `syncKvDomToDraft`, and hide `#navStyleGuideBtn` in `public/admin.js` when `admin_style_guide_workspace` is `hidden`.
findings.regression_risks: Ensure `tests/style-guide-admin.integration.cjs` and `tests/style-guide-admin-browser.e2e.cjs` pass with updated `categories_completed` counts.
findings.verification_steps: Complete all items in one Style Guide topic in `tests/style-guide-admin.integration.cjs` and assert `categories_completed === 1`, and verify `Cache-Control: no-store` on `GET /admin-style-guide.js`.

findings.title: Style Guide GitHub integration reads security-sensitive env vars without conflict detection, lacks outbound redirect/timeout bounds, and hardcodes personal developer email in public UI/code
findings.subsystem: S6: Feature controls & Style Guide admin workspace
findings.what_is_wrong: (1) `lib/style-guide-admin.js:64-95` reads `STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_API_URL`, `STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`, and `ENV` with `securityCritical: false` (unlike `lib/env-compat.js` fail-closed conflict detection used for auth/mail/push secrets) and does not enforce an `https://api.github.com` host allowlist when sending the `Bearer` GitHub PAT (`lines 1396-1435`, which also omits `redirect: "error"` and an overall push deadline). (2) `public/admin.html:1127`, `public/admin-style-guide.js:2601`, and `lib/style-guide-admin.js:1512` hardcode a developer's personal name and Gmail (`[REDACTED_PERSONAL_EMAIL]`) directly into served HTML/JS and server defaults instead of populating from the signed-in `Admin: Top` session (`ctx.user.email`).
findings.evidence: `lib/style-guide-admin.js:64-95` passes `{ securityCritical: false }` to `readEnvCompat`. `lines 1396-1435` (`githubApiJson`) calls `fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } })` without `redirect: "error"` or host allowlist validation on `STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_API_URL`. `public/admin.html:1127`, `public/admin-style-guide.js:2601`, and `lib/style-guide-admin.js:1512` hardcode personal Gmail defaults.
findings.expected_behavior: `STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_API_URL`, and `ENV` must use `securityCritical: true`; `githubApiJson` must enforce `https:` (allowing `http://127.0.0.1` only in `BITESHARK_ENV=test`), `redirect: "error"`, and bounded response sizes; and Git commit author defaults in `/admin` must derive from the authenticated `Admin: Top` user or neutral configuration rather than hardcoded personal PII.
findings.actual_condition: Conflicting `BITESHARK_*` vs `TRUCKLY_*` GitHub token/URL env vars do not fail closed, HTTP redirects could forward the `Authorization` header if `STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_API_URL` is misconfigured, and personal developer email PII is served in `/admin.html` and `/admin-style-guide.js`.
findings.impact: Bearer-token SSRF/redirect leakage risk on misconfiguration and unnecessary exposure of personal developer email in public static assets.
findings.root_cause: Local developer commit-identity defaults were copied into runtime web UI defaults, and `githubApiJson` skipped the outbound HTTPS/redirect guards used in `lib/standalone-auth.js` (Resend) and `lib/pager-notifications.js` (Web Push).
findings.recommended_remediation: Enable `securityCritical: true` on Style Guide token/API env reads, enforce `redirect: "error"` + `https://api.github.com` origin check (with loopback override strictly when `BITESHARK_ENV === "test"`), and default `#sgPushAuthorEmail` / `author_email` dynamically from the authenticated `Admin: Top` account (`state.user.email` / `actorEmail`).
implementation_steps: In `lib/style-guide-admin.js:64-95, 1396-1435`, set `securityCritical: true`, validate `apiBaseUrl` is `https://api.github.com` (or `http://127.0.0.1:*` only when `env === "test"`), and pass `redirect: "error"` to `fetch`.

Remove the hardcoded personal email from `public/admin.html:1127`, `public/admin-style-guide.js:2601`, and `lib/style-guide-admin.js:1512`, defaulting the UI input from the signed-in Top Admin's `actorEmail` (or requiring explicit input).
Document `BITESHARK_STYLE_GUIDE_*` keys in `docs/engineering/contracts/configuration-keys.json`.
findings.dependencies: Ensure `tests/style-guide-admin.integration.cjs` sets `BITESHARK_ENV=test` when pointing `BITESHARK_STYLE_GUIDE_GITHUB_API_URL` at its local `127.0.0.1` mock server.
findings.regression_risks: Verify `tests/style-guide-admin.integration.cjs` and `tests/style-guide-admin-browser.e2e.cjs` pass with dynamic `actorEmail` defaults.
findings.verification_steps: Grep `public/` and `lib/` to confirm zero hardcoded `@gmail.com` literals remain, and run `npm run test:style-guide:integration` + `npm run test:style-guide:browser`.

findings.title: Database pool fan-out (4 transactions per profile load), unbounded lifetime visit scan on saved trails, and 2 wasted RBAC queries per customer API call
findings.subsystem: S4: Customer profile, Greatest Hits sharing, exploration & photos
findings.what_is_wrong: Three concrete database efficiency bottlenecks compound on the 8-connection (`DB_POOL_MAX = 8`) VPS pool: (1) `getPrivateOwnerProfile` (`lib/customer-profile.js:842, 947-957`) runs `coreTx` and then fans out via `Promise.all([listUserVisits, listUserPhotos, listUserSavedTrails])`—checking out 3 simultaneous pooled connections per `/api/me/profile` request, re-acquiring `FOR SHARE` locks on `auth_users`/`auth_sessions` 4 times, and reading non-atomic snapshots; (2) `hydrateSavedTrailsInTx` (`lib/customer-exploration.js:2170-2179`) fetches EVERY active `customer_visits` row in the user's lifetime without filtering `AND recorded_vendor_id = ANY($2::text[])`; and (3) `handleGovernanceApiRequest` (`server/admin-routes.js:719`) runs `loadAccessContext` (2 SQL queries against `platform_roles` and `vendor_memberships`) BEFORE delegating `CUSTOMER_EXPLORATION_PATHS` and `CUSTOMER_PROFILE_PATHS` (`lines 971-997`), discarding `ctx` immediately!
findings.evidence: `server/index.js:50`: `DB_POOL_MAX` defaults to `8`. `lib/customer-profile.js:947-957`: `Promise.all([listUserVisits(dbAdapter, ...), listUserPhotos(dbAdapter, ...), listUserSavedTrails(dbAdapter, ...)])` outside `coreTx`. `lib/customer-exploration.js:2170-2179`: `SELECT ... FROM customer_visits WHERE user_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL` (unbounded). `server/admin-routes.js:719` runs `loadAccessContext` before `if (CUSTOMER_EXPLORATION_PATHS.has(normPath))` at `line 971` (which passes `verifiedUser: req.user`, not `ctx`!).
findings.expected_behavior: Customer exploration/profile delegation must run BEFORE `loadAccessContext` in `server/admin-routes.js`; `getPrivateOwnerProfile` must execute sequentially inside a single `withTransaction` (`tx`) checkout; and `hydrateSavedTrailsInTx` must restrict `customer_visits` to the distinct `recorded_vendor_id`s in `stopsRes`.
findings.actual_condition: Three concurrent `/profile` loads contend for 9 pool connections on an 8-connection pool while running 6 wasted RBAC queries and 3 full-history `customer_visits` scans.
findings.impact: Connection-pool exhaustion and tail-latency spikes under modest concurrent customer usage on the 961 MiB VPS.
findings.root_cause: Composable service functions (`listUserVisits`, etc.) were invoked with `dbAdapter` inside `Promise.all` instead of passing the active `tx` handle sequentially, and customer sub-routers were appended below `loadAccessContext` in `server/admin-routes.js`.
findings.recommended_remediation: Move `CUSTOMER_EXPLORATION_PATHS` and `CUSTOMER_PROFILE_PATHS` delegation above `loadAccessContext` in `server/admin-routes.js`, pass `tx` sequentially inside `getPrivateOwnerProfile`, and add `AND recorded_vendor_id = ANY($2::text[])` to `hydrateSavedTrailsInTx`.
implementation_steps: In `server/admin-routes.js`, move the `CUSTOMER_EXPLORATION_PATHS` and `CUSTOMER_PROFILE_PATHS` delegation blocks (`lines 971-997`) above `const ctx = await loadAccessContext(...)` (`line 719`)—after enforcing the central `isPreviewViewpoint` guard!

In `lib/customer-profile.js:842-960`, run `listUserVisits(tx, ...)`, `listUserPhotos(tx, ...)`, and `listUserSavedTrails(tx, ...)` sequentially inside `coreTx` (which `withTransaction` supports natively via nested-tx passthrough in `lib/db-tx.js:174-177`), and add `LIMIT 10` / `COUNT(*)` bounds on `favorites` (`line 860`).
In `lib/customer-exploration.js:2170-2182`, pass the deduplicated array of `recorded_vendor_id`s from `stopsRes` into `AND recorded_vendor_id = ANY($2::text[])`.
findings.dependencies: Keep sequential `await` (never `Promise.all`) when sharing a single `pg` `tx` client!
findings.regression_risks: Critical `pg` rule: never run `Promise.all` with multiple queries on the same `tx` (`PoolClient`); await `listUserVisits(tx)`, `listUserPhotos(tx)`, and `listUserSavedTrails(tx)` sequentially!
findings.verification_steps: Instrument connection checkout counts in `tests/customer-profile-sharing.integration.cjs` to confirm `GET /api/me/profile` checks out 1 connection instead of 4 and executes 0 `platform_roles` queries.

findings.title: Cross-account in-memory profile data and plaintext share URLs remain cached on 403 age-assessment and degraded 5xx auth transitions
findings.subsystem: S7: Customer-facing SPA frontend
findings.what_is_wrong: In `public/app.js:1685-1713` (`syncAuthAndUserData`), both the `403 requires_age_assessment` early-return branch (`lines 1685-1694`) and the degraded non-`401` branch (`lines 1696-1713`) call `window.bitesharkExploration.syncActiveUserScope(...)` while omitting `window.bitesharkProfile.syncActiveUserScope(...)` and `window.bitesharkResetProfileUiOnAuthChange()`. findings.title: Write-only dead sink admin_notification_outbox, 6 disconnected domain routes pinned by REGISTERED_DOMAIN_ROUTE_COUNT === 30, and 2 zero-UI admin endpoints
findings.subsystem: S2: HTTP server core, routing, api/* handlers & DB adapter
findings.what_is_wrong: (1) `admin_notification_outbox` (`migrations/018:300`) receives `INSERT`s during onboarding decisions (`server/admin-routes.js:3544, 3614`, returning `notification_delivery: "recorded_in_app_only"`), yet **zero `SELECT`, `UPDATE`, or `DELETE` queries** read, deliver, display, or purge `admin_notification_outbox` anywhere in the codebase! (2) Six domain routes in `server/routes.js` (`/api/trucks/list`, `/api/trucks/detail`, `/api/trucks/nearby` [superseded by `/api/trucks`], `/api/pager/list` [superseded by `/api/vendor/pagers`], `/api/community/moderate` [superseded by `/api/admin/moderation/decision`], and `/api/vendor/bookings` [superseded by `/api/owner/requests`]) have zero active frontend callers (or dead `community.js:286, 309` functions never triggered in UI) while being locked in place by contract `REGISTERED_DOMAIN_ROUTE_COUNT === 30`. (3) Governance endpoints `POST /api/admin/invitations/resend` (`line 4917`) and `POST /api/admin/style-guide/reset` (`line 8312`) have zero UI buttons and zero tests.
findings.evidence: Repository-wide search for `admin_notification_outbox` shows `CREATE TABLE` (`migrations/018:300`), `GRANT` (`018`/`025`), and `INSERT` (`server/admin-routes.js:3544, 3614`) — `0` `SELECT`s! `docs/engineering/generated/DRIFT-REPORT.md` confirms the 6 uncalled `api/*` domain routes; `AGENTS.md` enforces `REGISTERED_DOMAIN_ROUTE_COUNT === 30` against accidental deletion.

findings.title: Malformed percent-encoding on /s/... throws uncaught URIError (HTTP 500 without no-referrer header), and public/sw.js open_url check allows protocol-relative "//"
findings.subsystem: S2: HTTP server core, routing, api/* handlers & DB adapter
findings.what_is_wrong: (1) `server/app.js:1332-1333, 1352` calls `decodeURIComponent(segs[1])` and `decodeURIComponent(segs[3])` on `/s/...` routes outside `try/catch`. Invalid UTF-8 percent sequences (e.g., `GET /s/%E0%A4%A`) throw `URIError` before `applyUnlistedSharedSecurityHeaders` runs, hitting the global `500` JSON error handler (`Referrer-Policy: same-origin` + `unhandled_request_error` incident noise) instead of the uniform neutral `404` page. (2) `public/sw.js:39, 64` checks `open_url.startsWith("/")` without `&& !open_url.startsWith("//")`, which `new URL("//...", self.location.origin)` resolves as cross-origin.
findings.evidence: `server/app.js:1332`: `rawToken: decodeURIComponent(segs[1])` (unwrapped, unlike `resolveSafePublicFile` at `lines 421-425`). `public/sw.js:64-70`: `typeof notifData.open_url === "string" && notifData.open_url.startsWith("/")` -> `new URL(targetRelUrl, self.location.origin).href`.
findings.expected_behavior: Malformed percent-encoded `/s/...` URLs must safely decode to `""` and return the neutral `404` response with `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and `public/sw.js` should require `open_url.startsWith("/") && !open_url.startsWith("//")` (plus `parsed.origin === self.location.origin`).
findings.actual_condition: Scanner requests to `/s/%...` trigger `500` responses without `no-referrer` headers and pollute error diagnostics.
findings.impact: Scanner-triggered `500` diagnostic noise and minor referrer-header/SW URL-validation defense-in-depth gaps.
findings.root_cause: Direct `decodeURIComponent` call on raw `parsedUrl.pathname` segments.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add a `safeDecodeUriSegment` helper in `server/app.js:1330-1360` and reject `//` protocol-relative paths in `public/sw.js`.
implementation_steps: In `server/app.js:1328-1360`, wrap `decodeURIComponent` in `safeDecodeSegment(s)` returning `""` on `URIError`.
In `public/sw.js:39, 64, 70`, require `!open_url.startsWith("//")` and verify `new URL(targetRelUrl, self.location.origin).origin === self.location.origin`.
findings.regression_risks: None; valid `base64url` share tokens contain no `%` characters.
findings.verification_steps: Request `GET /s/%E0%A4%A` in `tests/customer-profile-sharing.integration.cjs` and assert `404` with `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.

findings.title: Code-registry SQL scanner misses 5 CREATE INDEX definitions lacking whitespace before "(", and scripts/dev-server.cjs is an outdated pre-017 mock server

findings.what_is_wrong: (1) `tools/code-registry/backend-db-analyzer.mjs:1773` uses `/...ON\s+(?:public\.)?"?([A-Za-z0-9_]+)"?\s+([^;]+);/gi` (`\s+` after table name), failing to parse 5 real PostgreSQL indexes written as `ON table(col)` without a space (`community_reviews_published_idx`, `community_reviews_author_idx`, `vendor_memberships_user_idx`, `audit_logs_vendor_idx`, `audit_logs_actor_idx`) and omitting them from `docs/engineering/generated/SCHEMA-INVENTORY.md`. (2) `scripts/dev-server.cjs` (`npm run dev:mock`) is a pre-Migration-017 in-memory mock server that lacks OTP `/api/auth/*`, `/api/account/context`, `/api/features`, `/api/me/*`, and `/api/admin/*`, breaking modern frontend flows when started.

findings.expected_behavior: `backend-db-analyzer.mjs:1773` should use `\s*` before `(` / `USING` so `SCHEMA-INVENTORY.md` indexes 100% of SQL indexes, and `scripts/dev-server.cjs` (`package.json` `dev:mock`) should clearly warn at startup that it is a legacy catalog-only preview (pointing developers to `server/index.js` + PostgreSQL per `START-HERE.md`).
findings.actual_condition: `SCHEMA-INVENTORY.md` under-counts indexes on `community_reviews`, `vendor_memberships`, and `audit_logs`, and `npm run dev:mock` serves broken auth/profile/admin UX.
findings.impact: Incomplete generated schema documentation and confusing local developer simulator behavior.
findings.root_cause: Regex required `\s+` before `(` in `CREATE INDEX`, and `scripts/dev-server.cjs` was not updated after standalone VPS runtime `server/index.js` replaced serverless dev workflows.
findings.recommended_remediation: Change `\s+([^;]+);` to `(?:\s+|(?=\())([^;]+);` in `tools/code-registry/backend-db-analyzer.mjs:1773`, run `npm run registry:docs`, and add a clear deprecation/scope banner to `scripts/dev-server.cjs`.
implementation_steps: Update `tools/code-registry/backend-db-analyzer.mjs:1773` regex to `(?:\s+|(?=\())([^;]+);`, then run `npm run registry:docs && npm run registry:validate && npm run test:registry`.
Print an explicit startup notice in `scripts/dev-server.cjs` clarifying it is a legacy static-catalog mock and recommending `node server/index.js` for authenticated/admin/profile testing.

findings.regression_risks: Verify `node tools/code-registry/cli.mjs validate --verify-db` in CI continues matching `pg_catalog` indexes.

findings.title: Single-node 1-vCPU / 961 MiB VPS co-tenancy constraints, per-process in-memory rate limiters, and intentionally unfinished 103-item Style Guide
findings.subsystem: S10: Deploy, systemd, Nginx, CI/CD, dependencies & code-registry
findings.what_is_wrong: Informational architectural constraints for operators and future agents: (1) Primary staging (`MemoryMax=192M`, `--max-old-space-size=128`), worker (`MemoryMax=128M`), secondary staging2 (`MemoryMax=160M`, `--max-old-space-size=96`), PostgreSQL 16, and Nginx share a single 1-vCPU / 961 MiB VPS—meaning synchronous CPU/memory spikes (like uncached 18-file Style Guide renders or concurrent `sharp` decodes without `sharp.concurrency(1)`) directly contend for scarce RAM; (2) HTTP/diagnostics rate limiters in `server/app.js` are in-memory `Map`s that reset on service restart (acceptable for single-process systemd units, but non-shared if horizontally scaled later); and (3) `docs/engineering/style-guide/decisions.json` is intentionally unfinished (`103` decisions tracked via `/admin#style-guide`) and must never be auto-filled by coding agents (`AGENTS.md`).
findings.evidence: `truckly-staging-api.service:12, 20` (`--max-old-space-size=128`, `MemoryMax=192M`), `biteshark-staging2-api.service:12, 20` (`--max-old-space-size=96`, `MemoryMax=160M`), `docs/engineering/style-guide/COMPLETION-REMINDER.md`.
findings.expected_behavior: Preserve `sharp.cache(false)` + `sharp.concurrency(1)`, keep `DB_POOL_MAX <= 8`, avoid adding heavy dependencies or multi-connection `Promise.all` fan-outs (`AUD-0033`), and upscale VPS RAM (`>= 2–4 GiB`) before public production launch.
findings.actual_condition: Well-engineered memory bounds (`MemoryMax`, `TasksMax`, `sharp.cache(false)`) protect the 961 MiB staging host today, but leave tight headroom during concurrent admin/photo operations.
findings.impact: Operational planning guidance prior to production cutover; no immediate code defect beyond `AUD-0031` and `AUD-0033`.
findings.root_cause: Intentional cost-efficient staging consolidation on a single Linode VPS.
findings.recommended_remediation: Maintain strict memory/pool discipline in code (`REP-028`, `REP-029`), document VPS sizing prerequisites (`>= 2 GiB` dedicated host + PostgreSQL-backed rate limits if multi-worker) in launch readiness checklists, and continue recording Style Guide decisions only from explicit team input.
implementation_steps: No immediate code change required beyond `REP-028` (Style Guide render memoization) and `REP-029` (single-connection profile transactions); evaluate dedicated >= 2 GiB production host sizing prior to apex `biteshark.live` launch.
findings.regression_risks: None.
findings.verification_steps: Monitor `systemctl status truckly-staging-api biteshark-staging2-api` memory high-water marks during staging verification.
